entry.title: Trace a failure
entry.use_when: Use observations and small experiments to isolate a cause.
entry.scope: Use observations and small experiments to isolate a cause.
entry.freshness: Verify source versions and the working environment before dependent use.
entry.limitations: Instructions for an existing assistant; tool access and successful outcomes are not implied.

pattern.activation: a failure needs diagnosis rather than a speculative rewrite.

use_cases.title: Trace a failure
use_cases.outcome: The leading explanation, supporting observations and the next discriminating check or verified fix.

links.why: Keeps the decisive observation and repair for later work.
